title: Tory Lanez & Melissia Rene React To Stefflon Don's Freestyle on Hot 97 With Funk Flex
htmlContent:
Earlier this week, Funk Flex unveiled the latest episode in its freestyle series at HOT'97, featuring the talented Londoner Stefflon Don. In the five-minute sequence, "Hurtin' Me" star began with reggae-Esque vibes before embarking on a quirky freestyle. In the middle, she decided to have fun with Flex, which left him stunned with humor:

“I’ma keep it all the way real, I wanna say some s***, I’m a Sagittarius and I get straight to the point. I’m not gonna lie, so I want you to look in my eyes when I say this to you … I ain’t f**** in a year but I’m ready to f***, I might just give my p**** to an O.G. buck like Funk Flex … you good Flex, you sure you good? You sure you good Flex? I’m just playin’, I ain’t really on no hood sex…” via Hollywood Unlocked.

In the comment sections, Melissia Rene and Tory Lanez reacted to the freestyle.

"It’s the DJ in the back for meeee screaming ," said Rene.

Lanez commented with emojis.

While Flex added, "Maria is not ok with this… at all!"

Speaking of Lanez, he recently revealed that The Weeknd and Drake have been dodging his request for collaborations for years.
